{"metadata":{"description":"AI-native engineering environment management that makes your codebase agent-ready.","id":"gh:1269057665","install_available":false,"language":"Rust","name":"terrain","slug":"sopaco/terrain","topics":["deepseek","deepwiki","dsh","dsh-plugin","knowledge-base","okf","okf-format"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"AI-native engineering environment management that makes your codebase agent-ready."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Terrain"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Terrain prepares the ground so agents don't have to guess where to stand.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Engineering environment management for human developers and AI coding assistants — knowledge as the "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"map, tools as the roads, conventions as the trail markers."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## App preview"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Project overview | Engineering knowledge | DeepWiki Q&A; | Agent environment |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"*From left to right: project list with freshness scores, auto-generated C4 docs, knowledge-grounded "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Q&A;, and one-command agent tooling setup.*"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Contents"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- What is Terrain?
- Install
- Getting started
- CLI command reference
- Why Terrain?
- Architecture"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"
- Ecosystem
- From Litho to Terrain
- License"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What is Terrain?"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Terrain is a **standardized, AI-friendly engineering environment**. Point it at a Git repository and"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" it delivers three things:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **🗺️ Engineering knowledge** — always-in-sync C4 docs and agent context, **produced from your code"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" and consumed by both humans and AI agents**.
- **🤝 A shared agent contract** — Skills, `AGENTS.md`,"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" and CLIs, so every coding agent reads the project the same way instead of blind-grepping the live r"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"epo.
- **⚙️ Auto-deployed tooling** — one command installs what your agents need (CodeGraph, RTK, pr"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"eset Skills); no per-repo yak-shaving."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"It runs as a **desktop app (GUI)** or a **CLI** — see Getting started for which to pick."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Three pillars"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Pillar | Metaphor | What you get |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| **Knowledge assets** | *Map* | Dual-track docs in `.terrain/`, produced from code |
| **Agent tool"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ing** | *Roads* | CodeGraph, RTK, and the Terrain CLI |
| **Conventions & workflow** | *Trail marker"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"s* | Skills, `AGENTS.md`, and the four-phase SDD workflow |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"One codebase, two audiences:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Audience | Path | Format |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| **Humans** | `.terrain/human/` | Narrative C4 docs with Mermaid diagrams |
| **AI agents** | `.ter"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"rain/agent/context.md` | Structured architecture overview (≤ 14 KiB) |
| **Source index** | `.terrai"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"n/agent/repomix.md` | Repomix pack — grep/read on demand, not preloaded |
| **Domain terms** | `.ter"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"rain/knowledge/` | Business glossary and internal conventions |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Knowledge factory"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Why it stands out"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Incremental** — tracks Git HEAD and regenerates only what changed, not the whole knowledge base."},{"id":"p23s2","text":"
- **Freshness-scored** — every asset carries a score; agents down-weight context below 50.
- **One "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"contract for every agent** — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor read the same layers through `"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"terrain tools`.
- **Toolchain in one command** — `terrain env apply` installs CodeGraph, RTK, and pr"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"eset Skills in dependency order.
- **Reviewable workflow** — SDD turns requirements → design → codeg"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"en → review into Markdown artifacts."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Performance & integration"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Native Rust core** — a single binary, no runtime, no database. Scan, pack, search, freshness, an"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"d env run fully offline with no LLM call.
- **Cross-platform** — prebuilt desktop installers for mac"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"OS (Apple Silicon) and Windows x64, plus `@terrain-ai/cli` on npm for headless machines and CI.
- **"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"Pipeline-friendly** — JSON stdout on every `terrain tools` call and NDJSON event streaming from `ter"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"rain ask query --stream`, so Terrain drops into CI jobs, PR checks, and agent loops without glue cod"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"in ask query --stream`, so Terrain drops into CI jobs, PR checks, and agent loops without glue code."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Option 1 — Prebuilt installer (recommended)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Download the package for your platform from **GitHub Releases** and open it — no Rust or Node toolch"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"package for your platform from **GitHub Releases** and open it — no Rust or Node toolchain required."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Platform | Asset |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `Terrain_<version>_macos_aarch64.dmg` |
| Windows (x64) | `Terrain_<versio"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"n>_windows_x64.exe` |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"> **Unsigned builds — first-launch notice.** The installers are not yet signed with an Apple Develop"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"er ID / Authenticode certificate, so both platforms raise a one-time warning. The download is intact"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"; see below to continue."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"#### macOS — "Terrain is damaged / should be moved to the Trash""},{"id":"p33s1","text":"This is Gatekeeper, not a corrupt file. Downloads from the internet carry a `com.apple.quarantine` a"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ttribute, and macOS refuses to launch an unsigned app with that flag set. Remove the flag after copy"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"ing `Terrain.app` to `/Applications`:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"#### Prerequisites"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- **Rust** — stable toolchain (MSRV 1.94; see rust-toolchain.toml)
- **Node.js / Bun** — frontend to"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"olchain and optional Node-based tools
- **LLM access** (optional) — OpenAI-compatible API, Ollama, o"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"r LM Studio (configure in the desktop app **Settings** panel)
- **Mainstream coding agent** (optiona"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"l) — e.g. Codex, DeepSeek Harness, or Claude Code, for knowledge composition and SDD codegen"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Why Terrain?"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Onboarding to a new codebase usually means days of reading source and stale wiki pages. Terrain comp"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"resses that to minutes: register a repo, run initialization, and get a full C4 doc set plus an agent"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"-ready context pack."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| Without Terrain | With Terrain |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"| Architecture knowledge scattered across wikis, Slack, and senior engineers | Engineering knowledge"},{"id":"p40s2","text":" assets generated from the actual codebase |
| AI assistants grep the live repo blindly | Agents rea"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"d `context.md` first, then targeted repomix slices |
| Docs drift from code on every refactor | Incr"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"emental updates + freshness tracking; knowledge travels with Git branches |
| Every team reinvents ""},{"id":"p40s5","text":"how to onboard an AI to our repo" | Env integration installs Skills, CodeGraph, RTK, and `AGENTS.md`"},{"id":"p40s6","text":"ard an AI to our repo" | Env integration installs Skills, CodeGraph, RTK, and `AGENTS.md` snippets |"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"**Built for:**"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"- **Developers** exploring or documenting a codebase
- **Tech leads** who want architecture docs tha"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"t stay close to the code
- **Teams** adopting AI coding assistants and need a shared knowledge contr"},{"id":"p42s3","text":"act
- **CI/CD** pipelines that regenerate knowledge assets on merge
- **ACP integrators** wiring `te"},{"id":"p42s4","text":"rrain tools` into Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or compatible agents"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"### System overview"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"Humans use the **desktop app** or **CLI**; external coding agents use the same contract via **`terra"},{"id":"p45s2","text":"in tools`** (JSON stdout). Assets live **in-repo** (`.terrain/` travels with branches); `~/.terrain/"},{"id":"p45s3","text":"registry.json` holds project pointers only."}],"truncated":true}
